Noor Al-Farsi  
Staff Frontend Engineer | InnovateTech Consulting  
Email: noor.al-farsi@innovatetech.com | Location: New York, NY  

A seasoned frontend engineer with 15 years of expertise in building scalable, accessible, and high-performance web applications. Specialized in leading frontend architecture, mentoring teams, and driving cross-functional initiatives in the consulting sector. Known for delivering measurable impact through strategic technical leadership and innovative problem-solving.  

**Technical Skills**  
Python: Spearheaded backend integration workflows at WebCraft Labs, reducing API latency by 35% through optimized data pipelines. Orchestrated Python-based automation scripts for CI/CD at Vortex Interactive, streamlining deployment cycles. Engineered Python-powered analytics dashboards that informed client ROI strategies.  
REST API design: Architectured scalable RESTful endpoints for a SaaS platform at Vortex Interactive, supporting 500k+ concurrent users. Redesigned legacy API structures at WebCraft Labs, improving request-response times by 40% and reducing error rates.  
Webpack/Vite: Transformed build pipelines at InnovateTech Consulting, cutting bundle sizes by 25% and accelerating load times. Integrated Vite into legacy projects, reducing first-contentful-paint times by 30% across client platforms.  
Next.js: Defined the frontend architecture for a global e-commerce platform, enabling server-side rendering and dynamic content delivery. Mentored 12+ engineers on Next.js best practices, reducing technical debt in 3 major client projects.  
React: Engineered core components for a real-time collaboration tool, achieving 98% code reuse across 50+ microservices. Led React migrations at WebCraft Labs, improving maintainability and reducing technical debt by 40%.  
TypeScript: Enforced type safety across InnovateTech’s codebase, eliminating 70% of runtime errors in 2 years. Designed type-driven interfaces for complex data flows, improving developer productivity by 30%.  
Web accessibility (WCAG): Redesigned compliance frameworks for a government client, achieving AA/AAA standards across all touchpoints. Trained 50+ developers on accessibility best practices, reducing audit failures by 85%.  
Web performance optimization: Implemented critical render path optimizations at Vortex Interactive, boosting Time to Interactive by 50%. Built performance monitoring tools that reduced load times by 25% across 10+ client projects.
